name: weekly_reconciliation_2026_08_23_29
claim: For the 2026-08-23 through 2026-08-29 architecture week, preserve one cross-repo provenance chain rather than treating each review fix as isolated. PT landed security/egress/observability/coordination work through PRs #362-#372; the MiniGraph reconciliation then established the one-scheduler GraphObservation/GraphEvent/GraphPlugin model, boundary-aware mutation semantics, recovered mined patterns, fail-closed GraphSpec placement, and durable deterministic resumability as an adopted R4 target. The blanket global no-mutation rule was located and superseded without weakening PT's append-only memory rule. The latest core review found two real remaining defects at the prior PR #1 head: mutable delta values were still caller-aliased despite deep=True, and checkout credentials were persisted into later PR-controlled steps. Both were implemented on the core branch at 488bc6cc440247ca86811c46ae0dd05869898324, but exact-head CI/review is still required before closure claims. Reusable operating rule: recall .agent first, fix source abstractions, preserve append-only provenance, verify exact SHA, re-sweep review threads, and distinguish deferred capability work from feature rejection.

decisions.notes: Direct operator instruction to record everything important from the week and apply all still-valid Claude/PT lessons while reconciling orama-system PR #333 and perpetua-core PR #1.
